system.description:
Elven law is a tradition stretching back to the dawn of time. This skill song concerns itself with the nature and application of Elven law.

Obstacles: Citadel law, Ob 1. Protector’s law, Ob 2. Etharchal law, Ob 3. Wilder law, Ob 4.

FoRKs: Any appropriate history or Wise skill or song

Skill Type: Academic. Tools: No.

Restrictions: Elves only

Root: Perception (§ magical skill: tests are open-ended)

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 282
